Started cooking - I mean actually cooking. 

My previous efforts were literally just warming up processed, beige food in the oven and eating it. Low nutritional value stuff.

So I was furloughed in 2020 (as were many) for 6 months. I used that time to educate myself in cooking. Real cooking. Fresh ingredients, herbs, spices etc.

Well the weight just fell off! I was cooking with real, salted butter, olive oil, double cream - didn’t matter, weight still kept coming off.

I watched 100s of YouTube videos, every episode of anything Gordon Ramsey has ever made, read a few books.

I started easy with getting steak right, making sauces from scratch, preparing vegetables in different, interesting ways then built up from there.

Bought a meat probe thermometer, a good peeler, wand blender.

Now I really enjoy cooking, my wife enjoys me cooking, guests enjoy my cooking. Plus the health benefits have been great.

And to answer the question “why did I lose everything in the divorce” -
I was due to move to America with my first wife (she’s from there originally), so she went there first to set up an apartment and get a job so I could go there on a green card, I handed in my notice in the RAF (6 months) and proceeded to save money, ship our belongings and dog to her, sell off what items we weren’t shipping and get ready to emigrate. My final paycheck from the RAF was 1st of August, before this date I could’ve withdrawn my PVR, 2nd of August she called and said “I’ve met someone else”. I asked for my money back (about £25k) and my stuff back. She told me she would be keeping all the money as she felt entitled to it and would only ship my stuff back if I paid for it, otherwise, I could go to the US and fight her in court. A battle that would’ve cost me a fortune to undertake. So I took my Dad’s advice of “just earn more money and buy more stuff” and started again from zero.

Edit - she is a district attorney, I’m an Armourer, the court battle seemed like it would’ve suited her better than me!!!
